issue: Nightly export to SFTP fails with timeout after 30s
resolution: Increased the SFTP timeout to 120s in their connector config; root cause was their firewall throttling

issue: Duplicate rows appearing in the orders table after re-sync
resolution: Enabled idempotent upsert mode (dedupe on order_id); explained that plain append mode re-inserts on retry

issue: CSV download button greyed out for viewer-role users
resolution: Working as designed — viewers cannot export; granted their analysts the editor role instead

issue: Webhook deliveries stopped after they rotated their API keys
resolution: Old key was still configured on webhook endpoint; walked them through re-registering webhooks after any key rotation

issue: Revenue dashboard shows numbers 5% lower than their internal reports
resolution: Their internal report included cancelled orders; added a toggle to include/exclude cancelled orders

issue: Export failing again with timeout even at 120s
resolution: Their nightly file grew past 2GB; switched them to chunked export mode which streams in 200MB parts

issue: Rate limited at 429 during their batch imports every Monday morning
resolution: Their cron fired 40 parallel workers; advised batching to 5 concurrent with exponential backoff and raised their limit tier

issue: Getting 401 errors intermittently since the key rotation ticket
resolution: They had two services using the deprecated key; audited usage via key-level logs and revoked the old key after migration

issue: Asking whether SyncPro supports Snowflake as a destination
resolution: Yes since v3.2; shared setup guide and noted their plan already includes it

issue: Scheduled email reports arriving at 3am instead of 8am local time
resolution: Their workspace timezone was UTC; set workspace timezone to Europe/Berlin and reports now send at 8am local
